title: RESTful Todo API
description: Containerized RESTful task management API built with FastAPI and Python 3.12, architected around Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design principles.
highlights: Layered Clean Architecture pattern (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API).
Relational database modeling with SQLModel and SQLite persistence layer.
Automated unit & integration test suites using pytest and service orchestration via Docker Compose.

title: Unity 2D Multiplayer .NET Backend Template
description: Enterprise C# & .NET Core boilerplate with SignalR for 2D multiplayer games and virtual spatial environments in Unity. Handles presence, movement, and spatial messaging in real time.
highlights: Real-time WebSocket synchronization using SignalR with spatial room grouping.
Cross-platform automation scripts to extract official SignalR .NET Standard 2.1 client DLLs into Unity.
Designed with Clean Architecture, EF Core, Redis Backplane support, and Docker containerization.

title: Sorting Algorithms & Benchmarks (.NET 10)
description: High-performance modular C# library in .NET 10 implementing fundamental sorting algorithms. Designed with Clean Architecture, generic constraints, xUnit unit testing, and BenchmarkDotNet memory profiling.
highlights: Decoupled implementations of QuickSort, MergeSort, HeapSort, InsertionSort, TimSort, and BubbleSort.
CPU performance and memory allocation profiling using BenchmarkDotNet.
Exhaustive unit test suite with xUnit and FluentAssertions.
